content.short: Coub is a short-video platform integrated with TON to reward creators and viewers for social engagement.
content.description: Coub is a well-known short-video platform specializing in 10-second looping videos that has recently integrated with the TON blockchain to embrace a Watch-to-Earn and Create-to-Earn model. It allows creators and viewers to earn COUB tokens based on their engagement and contributions to the platform. By bridging a traditional social media experience with Web3 incentives, Coub is transforming into a SocialFi hub where users are directly rewarded for the value they create within the community, leveraging TON for transparent and efficient reward distribution.
content.meta: Watch, create, and earn on Coub. The classic video platform, now on TON via Lancers Web3 Explorer.
